summary.en: The one object of a thread film, the line in the line colour in its profile (an even rule or a swelled rule), and the engine every thread scene draws with: the template's chain as a factory, its spheres and ink in WebGL.
summary.zh: thread 片子里唯一的物体：线色的那条线，带它的线形（等粗直线或中间鼓起的英式线）；也是每个 thread 场景用来画的引擎：模板的整条链做成工厂函数，球体和墨用 WebGL。

fits: Every scene of a thread film; a line that becomes a caret or a playhead elsewhere.
notFor: A line that must carry text or a status; more than one line colour.

intent.en: Keep one object on screen through the whole film: whatever happens, the line was there before and is there after.
intent.zh: 让同一个物体贯穿整部片：不管发生什么，那条线之前在、之后也在。

content.en: Nothing to read: the line's form (line, caret, playhead) and profile.
content.zh: 没有字：只有线的形态（线、光标、播放头）和线形。

fits.zh: thread 片子的每个场景；别处一条要变成光标或播放头的线。

notFor.zh: 要承载文字或状态的线；超过一种线色。

pairs.note: every thread scene draws through its engine

en: Under 4 px the line breaks the coloured-line-over-a-field rule: the swell's tips over the field carry nothing.
zh: 线细于 4 px 就违反“场色上的彩线”规则：英式线在场色上的尖端不承载任何东西。

source.path: assets/templates/thread/film.js (threadRect, swellPath, the links); shots.js; fx.js; gl.js; timing.rules.js

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
